about_the_game:
⛵ About This Game – Ghost In the Sail

Ghost In the Sail is a fantasy sailing-action game set on a cursed sea.
It blends precise ship handling, strategic spell-based combat, and tense boss encounters into a unique gameplay experience.

Read the wind, master your sails, and face off against ghostly foes.
Unleash ancient magic and reclaim the freedom of travel and trade for those still clinging to hope across these haunted waters.

⚔️ Parry, Dodge, Intercept

Combat is all about timing and reaction.
Using a combination of magic and cannon fire, you’ll parry incoming attacks, dodge at the last second, or intercept threats mid-air.

Skillful play fills your Morale Gauge, giving you the chance to turn the tide of battle and unleash a powerful counterstrike.

🌬️ Sailing Is the Core of Everything

Wind direction, velocity, and the inertia of your ship aren’t just effects — they’re central mechanics.
To survive, you must truly sail.

Nail the timing on sharp turns, position your broadsides, and cleave through deadly waters with precision.

🧭 Overcome Trials to Reach the Next Sea

Sailing and fighting alone won’t get you far.
To unlock new powers and dive deeper into dangerous territory, you’ll have to pass sacred Trials set by elders and rival sailors.

In Time Trials, prove your precision and speed.
Solve island puzzles and uncover forgotten knowledge — each success reveals the key to facing greater threats ahead.

🎮 Crafted Through Solo Dev

This game is developed solo with a focus on what matters:
tight, expressive combat, satisfying sailing mechanics, and a mysterious world that rewards mastery.

✅ Key Features

  • ⛵ Sailing mechanics at the heart of both movement and combat

  • 🗡️ Timing-based action to parry, dodge, and intercept enemy attacks

  • 💀 Tactical boss battles with Soulslike learning and adaptation

  • 🧭 Trials of speed and puzzle-solving drive both story and progression

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
